name: William W. Allen
roles: Family historian: compiled "Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams" (2010) and "Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams" (February 2012), continuing research begun by Ralph Allen
notable_stories: Says he shares his grandfather's love of making things and learned basic woodworking from him; was 19 when his grandfather died.
During his parents' marital troubles, his cousin Judith Allen acted as a second mother; he would drive to her place in Moorpark and stay a day or two.
milestones: Married Ruth Pamela Janes (m. 8 Dec 1991, La Casa de Maria, Santa Barbara, CA)
education: Associate of Arts, Santa Barbara City College, 1974
Studied photography, including with Ruth Bernhardt, Robert Werling and Michael Smith
B.S. Electrical Engineering, Ohio State University, 1987
M.S. Electrical Engineering, Ohio State University, 1990
Associate of Arts degree from Santa Barbara City College, 1974
Studied photography for several years, including with Ruth Bernhardt, Robert Werling and Michael Smith (names as written)
Returned to school in 1981 for electrical engineering; Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, 1987, Ohio State University
Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, 1990, Ohio State University
